scope: Refresh the status and evidence boundaries for the BRL-CAD explicit-PFACE consumer route, its proposed parser-safety patch, and currently surfaced open-source/commercial ACIS reader routes; update existing readiness gates only.

method.kind: Current public source/documentation review plus local source/test and plan inventory
method.limitations: BRL-CAD issue/PR descriptions are report-level evidence; this pass did not review PR #245's actual diff or reproduce the reported failure. CAD Assistant product documentation establishes a vendor route boundary, not behavior of this host's prior failed attempt. Peer source claims were not runtime-validated.

sources.observed: The public issue page still shows the reported dxf-g POLYFACE face-index out-of-bounds read as open. The report is not independently reproduced here and does not establish a libdxfrw defect.

The public PR page still shows the proposed fix as open/unmerged. Its description claims lower and upper pool bounds and skipping invalid faces; the actual diff was not reviewed or built. Require a merged immutable revision and inspect signed-index, visibility, zero-terminator, conversion-overflow, and actual-pool behavior before peer use.
The existing PFACE contract uses signed one-based indices; negative signs encode invisible edges and the first zero ends the active face-index sequence.

CAD Assistant lists ACIS SAT/SAB import through commercial XDE components and restricts export/conversion of models imported through those commercial components. This is not an open-source OCCT-core translator or a redistributable dependency.
The vendor's component notice places ACIS Import among Open CASCADE Platform added-value components accessed through Customer Corner.
The detailed SAT/SAB support row remains unsupported/planned despite broader project format headlines. No source build/runtime was attempted.
The project describes an early ACIS-to-B-rep route and relies on the ACadRust-derived OpenCAD codec lineage; it is an optional future kernel comparison, not an independent container parser.

filesInspected: DWG_DXF_OPEN_SOURCE_PARITY_PLAN.md: existing PAR-37/7V and S8 route entries
localEvidence.observed: The existing local guard widens signed indices, validates against actual coordinate children, and the generated ASCII/Binary test owner covers negative visibility, zero termination, advisory-count mismatch, ordering, out-of-range indices, and INT16_MIN. Tests were not executed during this research pass.

readiness: Do not use BRL-CAD dxf-g for malformed PFACE controls while the reported issue is unresolved and PR #245 remains unmerged/unreviewed.
If the local PFACE implementation changes, reuse the existing focused test owner; do not duplicate tests or promote B-rep support.
Treat OCCT commercial ACIS import as optional and separately licensed; do not add it to the open-source peer matrix or build graph.
Keep OpenCADKernel optional and conditional on an exact supported operation; local implementation continues without that external gate.
